name: The Pilgrimage to Skybell
description: Once a year, an individual can make a pilgrimage to Skybell; the arrival method is irrelevant, but it only produces effects once a year. When arriving at the Cathedral, the pilgrim can dedicate their first prayer to one of the eight statues of the main hall; they depict four different images of Tamera and Bauron, each one related to one of the Celestianist Orders. The pilgrim must pay eight percent of all it gained in the previous year, and if they do so, they will receive a sacred blessing, depending on the statue they choose to make their prayer.
